description: This file defines the LanguageTranslationController class, which manages language translation related operations within the OrangeHRM admin plugin. It extends the base AbstractVueController and uses traits and services to set up components for language translation editing, primarily handling the preRender lifecycle method.

classes.name: LanguageTranslationController
classes.description: Controller class for managing language translation views and operations within the admin plugin, specifically for rendering the language translation editing component.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares and sets up the language translation component for rendering, based on the language ID provided in the request. It fetches language details and throws an exception if the language is not valid or enabled.
